newsitem.title: USA: Roberts Pharmaceutical adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Roberts Pharmaceutical adopts rights plan.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday it has adopted a shareholders rights plan to protect shareholder value if there is an attempted takeover.

If there is an acquisition of or tender offer for 15 percent or more of Robert's common stock, shareholders would be entitled, at an initial exercise price of $80 per right, to buy common stock from the company at a 50 percent discount from the market price, Roberts said.
If Roberts is merged, the rights would let shareholders buy shares of the acquiror's common stock at a 50 percent discount, Roberts said.

Yamanouchi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd owns about 22 percent of Roberts outstanding common stock. Under agreement, Yamanouchi can increase its holdings to 30 percent or tender for all outstanding Roberts common shares without triggering the rights plan, Roberts said.
Roberts said all rights expire December 2006 unless it redeems them earlier.
